name: MOS Food Services Inc
summary: Mos Food Services, Inc. is a hospitality company that manages its popular MOS BURGER hamburger franchise alongside a diverse portfolio of other food service establishments, catering to customers both within Japan and across global markets. Among its offerings are MOS CAFÉ locations, serving a selection of beverages, desserts, and alcoholic drinks. It also runs Mother Leaf specialty black tea shops, renowned for their fresh black tea, various sweets, coffee, handcrafted desserts, and a menu featuring pasta and other meals. The company further extends its reach with Mother Leaf Tea Style, a café specializing in innovative black tea creations, as well as MOSDO! outlets. Additionally, it owns and operates restaurants under the distinct brand names chef's V, GREEN GRILL, and AEN. Established in 1972, the company maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
